title: Why The Bottom 50% Is Losing Money Right Now
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Top 0.1% gain mainly from equities; inflation erodes savings, so ordinary people should invest long term in quality companies without leverage.
Markets at all-time highs; a pullback would be an opportunity to buy more, as he did in the tariff selloff.

notes: Promotional/educational video (Seeking Alpha Alpha Picks). Mentions holdings (AMD, NVDA, GOOGL, AAPL, UNH, SPCX/SpaceX, MSFT, MU) and YTD leaders only in passing; no actionable calls.
